title: Require Service Spine Topology
forbids: a standalone service outside its closed package and public client/service surface; a module directory outside canonical lowercase kebab naming; a missing root or module anchor; shared, internal, dependencies, procedure, operation, loose schema, or unbounded database buckets; model matter outside direct named semantic leaves; model index.ts authority; a module without AGENTS.md, its router.ts composition face, or named router leaves; router/index.ts authority; or an unsealed middleware directory
why: A service is a narrowing capability funnel. Closing each hierarchy layer gives every fact one local owner: the canonical module namespace identifies usable native service branches and admitted subdomain boundaries, base and module anchors own context projection, direct model leaves keep their dependency edges visible, module AGENTS.md records product context, middleware files own qualified guards, named router leaves own operation behavior, and module router.ts owns their one plain composition face.
remediate: Keep package.json, project.json, src, and tsconfig.json at a standalone service package root; keep client.ts beside service under src; keep base.ts, contract.ts, impl.ts, modules, and router.ts at the service interior; name each direct module directory with lowercase alphanumeric kebab segments beginning with a letter; and keep AGENTS.md, contract.ts, module.ts, router.ts, plus router/*.router.ts in every admitted module. Put model matter only in direct leaves under actors, dto, errors, helpers, policy, ports, or prompts, and import those leaves directly without index.ts. Do not add a service db boundary until a separate positively closed database blueprint owns it. Author operations in named router leaves and compose them in module/router.ts; do not add router/index.ts. The agent-router blueprint owns AGENTS.md source shape and the remaining repository placements.
message: Service packages must follow the closed capability funnel with module AGENTS.md, direct model leaves, named operation routers, and one module router.ts composition face.
